remarks: The cabin the woods! 5.607 Acres of peace and country living on a private road. Featuring a beautiful, stocked pond to the right of the house. To the left of the house is your detached 2 car garage with a lean to attached for many needs; and also, a shed. The areas fenced in were to keep the dogs from getting lost in the wilderness. With a new septic put in last year, new hot water tank, and insulation installed; this can not only be a cabin but a year-round residence. Three bedrooms upstairs; one has a bonus room that could be a walk-in closet, two are carpeted. One full bath upstairs and downstairs. First floor laundry. All appliances are run on electric there is no gas or propane. There are two entrances in, Front porch leading into living room or side door that goes into a bonus room; currently used as an office space. Beautiful wood covers the walls inside giving it a rustic feel. As Is, make it your own!
